subject.title: feat(repair): add digest-bound Gitcrawl evidence intake

question: Should Gitcrawl repair intake permanently require `gitcrawl-evidence-job-v1`, quarantine legacy jobs, and support local, cloud, and strict parity providers under the new fail-closed contract?
rationale: The implementation is coherent, but it intentionally removes the previous accepted-job behavior and establishes a long-term external provider contract that automated review cannot authorize.

options.title: Approve strict contract
options.body: Accept evidence-required jobs, legacy quarantine, and all three provider modes after conflict resolution and integrated-head operational proof.

options.title: Phase strict enforcement
options.body: Preserve a temporary legacy compatibility path while operators migrate existing jobs.

options.title: Land local mode first
options.body: Merge immutable local evidence binding and defer cloud and parity support to a separate approval.

recommendation.title: Approve strict contract
recommendation.body: Accept evidence-required jobs, legacy quarantine, and all three provider modes after conflict resolution and integrated-head operational proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc introduced the current import path and owns the proposed replacement contract.
